RFC9072-2-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 by an independent judge after 375ccbf4f6 changed the negative unit, against rfc/full/rfc9072.txt Section 2: 'if the length of the Optional Parameters in the BGP OPEN message does exceed 255, the OPEN message MUST be encoded according to the procedure below' (Non-Ext OP Len 255, Non-Ext OP Type 255, two-octet Extended Opt. Parm. Length, and 'the Parameter Length field is extended to be a two-octet unsigned integer'). Negative message TestTheExtendedEnvelopeAndItsParametersAgree now packs through capability.PackOptionalParams and writes through Open.WriteTo, then reads the written octets as a receiver: at base forms 256, 257, 302 and two parameters 257 it requires the 255/255 envelope, an Extended Opt. Parm. Length equal to the octets that follow, and a two-octet walk that tiles them exactly with each packed type and value; at base form 255 it requires the RFC 4271 envelope. The prior weak finding (input already in two-octet framing, opaque round trip) is resolved: the parameters now come from the packer. The recorded discrimination break (PackOptionalParams body replaced by panic) proves only that the unit reaches the packer, so the judge ran overlay mutants of PackOptionalParams, tracked file untouched, against a green HEAD: M1 extended branch packing one-octet lengths fails 'parameter 0: two-octet Parameter Length 65184, want 254' on all four extended cases; M2 the off-by-two threshold (baseOctets <= 257, the original defect) writes the 255/255 envelope around one-octet parameters at 256 and 257 and fails the same walk; M3 a threshold one low fails '255/255 envelope written = true, want false' at 255. Positive carriers unchanged: reactor TestRFC9072OptionalParamsBoundary drives Session.buildOpen at capability totals 0..300 and asserts every octet of the procedure at 254 and above, message TestOpenPackExtendedParams the 300-octet envelope. Both polarities hold and the negative violates this requirement, not a neighbour.

RFC9072-2-2.note: TestRFC9072ShortExtendedOpenIsAccepted: an extended OPEN with 9 parameter octets decodes with no error, ExtendedParams true, parameters exact, ASN4 4200000001 parsed; a classic reading of the same octets does not recover it; the classic OPEN of the same capability decodes ExtendedParams false to the same capability.

RFC9072-2-3.note: {single-polarity: positive} on the row. TestOpenPackExtendedParams requires body[9]==0xFF and now the exact body length; writeToExtended writes the constant.

RFC9072-2-4.note: {single-polarity: positive} on the row. TestOpenPackExtendedParams requires body[10]==0xFF; writeToExtended writes the constant.

RFC9072-3-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent auditor). Unit changed only by the move to the one packer (capability.PackOptionalParams via packPeerOptionalParams). TestRFC9072ParameterType255OnlyAsTheExtendedMarker fills capability values with 0xFF octets, writes the OPEN and walks the framing the OPEN announces: below 256 octets no envelope and types [2]; above, the 255/255 envelope and every parameter type 2, framing ending exactly at the OPEN's end. TestOpenPackExtendedParams carries the positive marker position. A packer emitting 255 as a parameter type, or the marker on a short OPEN, goes red.
